title: Structure language grants and choices (ancestry + background)
description: Languages are prose-only. Background: background:acolyte data.languages = 'Two of your choice'. Ancestry: languages appear in a trait, e.g. ancestry:elf trait 'Languages' text 'You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.' The engine cannot enumerate granted/chosen languages without parsing prose.
acceptance_criteria: Add structured language metadata: fixed granted languages plus 'choose N' counts, on ancestry and background schema/importer. Regenerate via importer (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md) with audit coverage. Likely files: importers, kindSchemas.ts validateDnd5eAncestry/validateDnd5eBackground, rulesPackResolver.ts.
notes: Review fix pushed + rebased onto main (PR #308 now MERGEABLE). enumerateLevel1RequiredChoices computes combined ancestry+background fixed languages and subtracts that set from every free-choice from pool (was only excluding the same entry's own fixed). Regression test: Half-Elf + Acolyte — both language pools exclude Common+Elvish. verify:worktree green (2556 passed/19 skipped).
close_reason: Merged via PR #308. Source-cited language overlay (srdLanguages.ts) keyed to frozen ancestry/background keys: fixed languages + free-choice counts; SRD_STANDARD_LANGUAGES + chooseableLanguages pool. requiredChoices grants fixed languages silently, surfaces only free picks as structured choose/from, and excludes the COMBINED ancestry+background fixed set from every pool (review fix).
